mapper.select: SELECT o.org_id AS orgId, o.parent_org_id AS parentOrgId, o.org_name AS orgName, o.org_type AS orgType, o.org_level AS orgLevel, o.sort_order AS sortOrder, COALESCE(m.member_count, 0) AS memberCount FROM organization o JOIN org_closure c ON c.descendant_org_id = o.org_id JOIN organization root ON root.org_id = c.ancestor_org_id AND root.parent_org_id IS NULL LEFT JOIN ( SELECT h.org_id, COUNT(*) AS member_count FROM employee_hr_info h JOIN employee e ON e.employee_id = h.employee_id WHERE e.employ_state IN ('WORK', 'LEAVE') GROUP BY h.org_id ) m ON m.org_id = o.org_id WHERE o.is_active = TRUE ORDER BY c.sort_path ASC

SELECT e.employee_id AS employeeId, e.employee_name AS employeeName, h.org_id AS orgId, o.org_name AS orgName, f.file_url AS profileFileUrl, e.email AS email, e.phone AS phone, e.ext AS extensionNum, p.position_name AS positionName, j.job_name AS jobName, r.rank_name AS rankName, w.area_name AS areaName, e.employ_state AS employeeState, CASE WHEN p.position_name IN ('대표이사', '대표', '본부장', '센터장', '부서장', '팀장', '실장') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS leaderSort, COALESCE(r.rank_no, 0) AS rankNo FROM employee_hr_info h JOIN employee e ON e.employee_id = h.employee_id LEFT JOIN organization o ON o.org_id = h.org_id LEFT JOIN hr_file f ON f.hr_file_id = e.profile_id LEFT JOIN hr_position p ON p.position_id = h.position_id LEFT JOIN job j ON j.job_id = h.job_id LEFT JOIN hr_rank r ON r.rank_id = h.rank_id LEFT JOIN working_area w ON w.area_id = h.area_id WHERE h.org_id = #{orgId} AND e.employ_state IN ('WORK', 'LEAVE') ORDER BY rankNo DESC, e.employee_name ASC
SELECT h.org_id FROM employee_hr_info h WHERE h.employee_id = #{employeeId} LIMIT 1

SELECT e.employee_id AS employeeId, e.employee_name AS employeeName, h.org_id AS orgId, o.org_name AS orgName, f.file_url AS profileFileUrl, e.email AS email, e.phone AS phone, e.ext AS extensionNum, p.position_name AS positionName, j.job_name AS jobName, r.rank_name AS rankName, w.area_name AS areaName, e.employ_state AS employeeState, CASE WHEN p.position_name IN ('대표이사', '대표', '본부장', '센터장', '부서장', '팀장', '실장') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS leaderSort, COALESCE(r.rank_no, 0) AS rankNo FROM org_closure c JOIN employee_hr_info h ON h.org_id = c.descendant_org_id JOIN employee e ON e.employee_id = h.employee_id LEFT JOIN organization o ON o.org_id = h.org_id LEFT JOIN hr_file f ON f.hr_file_id = e.profile_id LEFT JOIN hr_position p ON p.position_id = h.position_id LEFT JOIN job j ON j.job_id = h.job_id LEFT JOIN hr_rank r ON r.rank_id = h.rank_id LEFT JOIN working_area w ON w.area_id = h.area_id WHERE c.ancestor_org_id = #{ancestorOrgId} AND e.employ_state = 'WORK' AND (#{filterOrgId} IS NULL OR h.org_id = #{filterOrgId}) ORDER BY rankNo DESC, e.employee_name ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM org_closure c JOIN employee_hr_info h ON h.org_id = c.descendant_org_id JOIN employee e ON e.employee_id = h.employee_id WHERE c.ancestor_org_id = #{ancestorOrgId} AND e.employ_state = 'WORK' AND (#{filterOrgId} IS NULL OR h.org_id = #{filterOrgId})
